msg: To start with, this looks incredibly easy, then you realise that you haven't much time. Calm down, enjoy the scenery, and you will have plenty of time. You might even be too slow, in which case you'll get nothing that round. 200 rounds sounds a lot, but it isn't. Also, if you're working on using a gnome's colour to decide, remember that the gnome you *don't* pick turns grey, so that might make you think that grey gnomes actually exist: they don't. Best of luck!
